interpretation: Diagnostic steps are excluded from synchronized end-to-end measurement samples.
CPU region durations include host elapsed time; nested regions overlap and must not be summed.
GPU annotation spans can include launch gaps and overlap; these are not summed kernel busy time.
Compiler regions are CPU trace events and may nest; do not add all compiler totals.
Only pre-extracted small JSON summaries are read; the full trace is neither loaded nor hashed.

gpu_ownership.timestamp_basis: Local timestamps as emitted by nvidia-smi and benchmark logger; timezone not encoded in these files.
gpu_ownership.window_basis: Optimizer setup log through final median report, inclusive of warmup and every measured step. Final timestamp extended by one second for second-resolution logger.
limitations: Polling is approximately 1Hz; subsecond competing processes cannot be ruled out.
Compute-process inventory does not establish absence of graphics work or CPU contention.
Earlier baseline profile window precedes the ownership capture and is not covered by this audit.
gpu_ownership.source_csv_hash_scope: Captured prefix of source_csv_bytes bytes; live monitoring continues after this audit.
